security.csp: default-src 'self'; script-src 'self'; style-src 'self'; img-src 'self' data:; connect-src ipc: http://ipc.localhost

bundle.shortDescription: Move files to the cloud, prove every one arrived intact, then free the space.
bundle.longDescription: Offload uploads a folder to any cloud rclone supports, compares every file with its cloud copy by checksum, and only then offers to remove the local originals.
